verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Automations, which run cloud agents in the background either on a schedule (presets or cron) or in response to events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks and Linear. Users can create them in the Agents Window, at cursor.com/automations, from Marketplace templates, or by describing them in plain language with the /automate skill. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably and unattended in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Cursor Automations run cloud agents in the background, either on a schedule or in response to events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks, Linear, and more.
The `/automate` skill lets you describe the workflow you want in plain language. Cursor configures the automation's triggers, instructions, and tools for you.
Set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix your software.
